decisions.reason: Escalation of commitment favors keeping this recently launched, close-to-core weir product because the firm has already invested and publicly mentioned it, and any weak market response can still be attributed to its short time on the market.
Given its fit with the firm's announced direction toward energy recovery and digital control, sunk costs and public commitment make persistence likely despite limited website visibility.
With a dedicated product page and several models, this product represents the most visible and substantial commitment, so escalation pressures strongly favor keeping it.
